$comment: Forbidden-identifier rules for the MentorRecorder hard boundary.
The patterns live in this data file (not in check.py) so that the
checker's own source contains no literal match. This directory is
itself excluded from the scan. See docs/privacy-boundary.md.
'contracts/' is deliberately not scanned: the IPC schema states the boundary
in prose ('no TCP, no WebSocket'), which is documentation, not code.
'scan_dirs' are walked recursively; 'scan_files' are individual files
relative to the repository root (the root CMakeLists.txt and the shared
MSBuild files live there and would otherwise never be looked at).
Every 'pattern' is a Python regular expression matched per line.
A line containing the allow_marker is skipped (use it only for
boundary-enforcing code that must name a forbidden symbol).
A rule may name the files it does not apply to. 'allow_paths' lists
repository-relative, forward-slash FILE paths matched exactly (not by file
or directory name); 'allow_path_prefixes' lists directory prefixes that must
end in '/'. Each allowance lifts only its own rule, and every one must be
explained in docs/privacy-boundary.md (NET-006/NET-007: sections 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4).
A rule id may be declared more than once when every entry names a distinct
'variant' (lower-case token). Violations are still reported under the id; each
entry has its own pattern and its own allowances, so the shared-calibration
client may name its CDN hosts but not the speech host, the online-speech
client the speech host but not the CDN hosts, and the update-check client the
content host but neither the CDN hosts nor the speech host.

rules.message: 读取其他进程内存被禁止 / reading another process's memory is forbidden
写入其他进程内存被禁止 / writing another process's memory is forbidden
在其他进程中分配内存被禁止 / remote memory allocation is forbidden
远程线程注入被禁止 / remote thread injection is forbidden
全局/远程消息钩子被禁止 / installing Windows hooks is forbidden
底层注入原语被禁止 / low-level injection primitives are forbidden
禁止打开游戏进程句柄；只允许进程存在性检查与系统 TCP 表 / opening a handle to another process is forbidden; only process existence checks and the system TCP table are allowed
Deucalion 注入式钩子必须保持关闭 / the Deucalion injected hook must stay disabled
禁止使用 Deucalion 注入式抓包 API / the Deucalion injected-capture API must not be used
禁止引用/分发 Deucalion 注入载荷 / the Deucalion injection payload must not be referenced or shipped
禁止调用注入载荷的加载入口 / the injection payload's loader entry points must not be called
禁止发送数据包 / sending packets is forbidden (capture is strictly passive)
禁止注入数据包 / injecting packets is forbidden (capture is strictly passive)
只允许 Npcap/WinPCap 抓包模式，禁止 RawSocket 回退 / only the Npcap (WinPCap) monitor type is allowed, no raw-socket fallback
只允许 Npcap/WinPCap 抓包，禁止使用 raw socket 抓包实现 / only the Npcap (WinPCap) capture socket is allowed, never the raw-socket one
禁止把原始报文写入抓包文件 / dumping raw packets to a capture file is forbidden
禁止直接 P/Invoke pcap 原生库，抓包只经由 Machina 的 WinPCap 监视器 / no direct P/Invoke into the pcap native libraries; capture goes through Machina's WinPCap monitor only
禁止 HTTP 监听器，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no HTTP listener; IPC is Named Pipe only
禁止 TCP 监听器，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no TCP listener; IPC is Named Pipe only
禁止 WebSocket，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no WebSocket; IPC is Named Pipe only
禁止内嵌 Web 服务器 / no embedded web server
桌面端不得监听任何端口或管道，只作为命名管道客户端 / the Desktop process must not listen; it is a Named Pipe client only

禁止外发网络请求；例外只有共享校准获取客户端、在线语音客户端与更新检查客户端（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.2、§8.3、§8.4） / no outbound network requests; the only exceptions are the shared-calibration fetch client, the online-speech client and the update-check client (docs/privacy-boundary.md sections 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4)
共享校准 CDN 的主机名只允许出现在获取客户端、公开仓库脚本目录与开发期数据生成器 / the shared-calibration CDN host names may only appear in the fetch client, tools/shared-calibration/ and the dev-time duty-data generator

内容分发主机名只允许出现在共享校准获取客户端、更新检查客户端、公开仓库脚本目录与开发期数据生成器（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.2、§8.4） / the content host name may only appear in the shared-calibration fetch client, the update-check client, tools/shared-calibration/ and the dev-time duty-data generator (docs/privacy-boundary.md sections 8.2 and 8.4)
在线语音服务的主机名只允许出现在在线语音客户端（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.3） / the online-speech host name may only appear in the online-speech client (docs/privacy-boundary.md section 8.3)
禁止任何形式的游戏自动化/模拟输入 / synthetic input and game automation are forbidden
